dialogue.content: 今日はよろしくお願いします。お時間になったら始めますね。
dialogue.English: Thank you for coming today. We'll begin when it's time.

dialogue.content: こちらこそよろしくお願いします。了解です。
dialogue.English: Thank you as well. Understood.

dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員です。今日はお越し頂きありがとうございます。初めに、あなたの年齢、性別を教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm the counselor. Thank you for coming in today. To begin, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: 14歳、女です
dialogue.English: I'm 14 years old, female.

dialogue.content: 教えて頂きありがとうございます。今日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that. What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: 学校に行く勇気が持てなくて、どうしたらいいか悩んでいます、、、
dialogue.English: I can't bring myself to go to school, and I'm not sure what to do...

dialogue.content: ええ、ええ、それはお辛いですね
dialogue.English: I see, that must be very difficult for you.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 学校はいまどれくらい行ってないのですか？
dialogue.English: How long has it been since you've been to school?

dialogue.content: 半年くらい行ってないです
dialogue.English: It's been about six months.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね、
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 半年いかないと、行くのに勇気がいりますよね。
dialogue.English: After six months, it must take a lot of courage to go back.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ええ、学校に行くってなった時にどんなことが頭に浮かんだらしますか？
dialogue.English: When you think about going to school, what kinds of thoughts come to mind?

dialogue.content: 行きたくないなって感じです嫌だなみたいな
dialogue.English: I just feel like I don't want to go... like I dread it.

dialogue.content: ええ、はい、嫌な気持ちになるんですね。
dialogue.English: I see, yes. It brings up unpleasant feelings for you.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ええ、半年前までは、学校に対するイメージはどんなものでしたか？
dialogue.English: I see. Before six months ago, what was your impression of school?

dialogue.content: うーん特に何も
dialogue.English: Hmm, nothing in particular.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 学校は学校ですかね
dialogue.English: School was just school, I guess.

dialogue.content: そのように思われるのですね、いまあなたが苦しんでる気持ちをどなたかご存知だったりするのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see that's how you felt. Does anyone know about how you're struggling now?

dialogue.content: 両親に話しました
dialogue.English: I've told my parents.

dialogue.content: ええ、そうでしたか、
dialogue.English: I see, you did.

dialogue.content: どのようなことを言ってましたか？
dialogue.English: What did they say?

dialogue.content: 今は学校に無理に行かなくてもいいと言われます
dialogue.English: They tell me I don't have to force myself to go to school right now.

dialogue.content: ええ、そうなんですね、
dialogue.English: I see, so that's what they said.

dialogue.content: それを聞いてあなたはどう思いました？
dialogue.English: How did you feel when you heard that?

dialogue.content: なんか複雑でした…
dialogue.English: I felt... conflicted.

dialogue.content: うんうん、
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: よかったらその複雑な気持ち教えてもらってもいいですか？
dialogue.English: If you're comfortable, could you tell me more about those conflicted feelings?

dialogue.content: 話せることからで大丈夫ですよ。
dialogue.English: You can start with whatever you feel able to talk about.

dialogue.content: 学校に通わないでいる不安や、この先が不安だなと。
dialogue.English: I feel anxious about not going to school, and I'm worried about the future.

dialogue.content: ええ、そう思うんですね、心配になりますよね、
dialogue.English: I see, you feel that way. It's natural to be worried.

dialogue.content: はい…
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: 先のことで、具体的にどんなことが不安だったりしますか？
dialogue.English: Specifically, what kinds of things about the future make you anxious?

dialogue.content: みんなと同じように普通の学校生活送れてないから、このまま引きこもりで一生終わっていく気がして…
dialogue.English: I'm not having a normal school life like everyone else, so I feel like I'm just going to be a shut-in for the rest of my life...

dialogue.content: うんうん、そうやって考えるとすごくしんどくなるよね…
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm, thinking that way must be incredibly overwhelming...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ええ、そう思うのも自然だと思います、
dialogue.English: It's natural to feel that way.

dialogue.content: 学校に行きたくない気持ちと、両親が無理に行かなくてもいいって言ってくれてるので、行かなくてもいい安心感とでもこのまま自分が学校に行けないでずっと家で引きこもりになったらどうしよう、それは嫌だなっていう不安
dialogue.English: So there's the feeling of not wanting to go to school, and a sense of relief from your parents saying you don't have to force yourself, but at the same time, there's the anxiety of 'What if I can't go to school and just become a shut-in at home forever? I don't want that.'

dialogue.content: このような感情があなたの中にあるのですね、
dialogue.English: It sounds like you have all of these feelings inside you.

dialogue.content: 安心感はあまりないですが、そんな感じです
dialogue.English: I don't feel much relief, but that's basically it.

dialogue.content: ええ、そうなんですね、
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 毎日ずっと悩んで、苦しい思いをされてるのだと思います。
dialogue.English: It sounds like you've been struggling with this every day and are in a lot of pain.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ええ、今日ここであなたが少しでも明るい方向に向かえるヒントを一緒にお話しできたらと思います
dialogue.English: I hope we can talk together today and find even a small hint to help you move in a brighter direction.

dialogue.content: もう少しあなたのことを教えて頂きたいのですが
dialogue.English: I'd like to ask a bit more about you, if that's okay.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 半年前くらいから、学校に行くのに勇気がいると聞きました、
dialogue.English: You mentioned that since about six months ago it takes courage to go to school.

dialogue.content: そのくらいの時期に学校でどんなことがありましたか？
dialogue.English: Around that time, what happened at school?

dialogue.content: 2年生になってクラスの子に目つきが悪いし暗いと笑われてから、みんなが私を見て笑ってきる気がして、、
dialogue.English: After I started second year, some kids in my class laughed at me and said my eyes looked mean and that I was gloomy. Since then, I feel like everyone is looking at me and laughing...

dialogue.content: ええ、ええ、そんなことがあったんですね、
dialogue.English: I see—I’m sorry that happened.

dialogue.content: そう思うとすごく学校に行くのが怖いですよね
dialogue.English: Feeling that way must make it very scary to go to school.

dialogue.content: それから、学校行こうとすると吐き気がして行けなくなりました
dialogue.English: After that, I started feeling nauseous whenever I tried to go to school, so I couldn't go.

dialogue.content: はい、怖いです…
dialogue.English: Yes, it's scary...

dialogue.content: ええ、心無い言葉を言われてとても傷付きましたよね、
dialogue.English: Yes, those heartless words must have hurt you very deeply.

dialogue.content: はい…
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: ええ、よく耐えましたよね、
dialogue.English: Yes. You've endured so much.

dialogue.content: そのようなことを言ってきた人は1人？
dialogue.English: Was it just one person who said those things?

dialogue.content: いえ、何人かいました
dialogue.English: No, there were several of them.

dialogue.content: そうだったんだ、それは辛かったね。
dialogue.English: I see. That must have been so painful.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: それを言われた時ってどんな状況だったのかな？言える範囲で大丈夫なので、もう少し教えて頂くことはできますか？
dialogue.English: What was the situation like when they said that? If you're comfortable, could you tell me a little more, just what you're able to share?

dialogue.content: 言われた時は普段通り席に座ってた気がします。
dialogue.English: I think I was just sitting at my desk as usual when they said it.

dialogue.content: でも元々自分の顔に自信がないので、笑われるくらい醜いんだなと思って恥ずかしくなりました。
dialogue.English: But I've never been confident about my face, so I thought I must be ugly enough to be laughed at, and I felt ashamed.

dialogue.content: ええ、そうだったんですね、そんなことをいきなり言われたのですか？
dialogue.English: I see, so that's what happened. Did they just say that to you out of the blue?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ええ、行きたがってしまってすみません、
dialogue.English: I see. I'm sorry for pressing you.

dialogue.content: いえ
dialogue.English: No, it's okay.

dialogue.content: そんなことないと思いますよ、否定された気持ちになったんですね、
dialogue.English: I don't think that's true at all. It must have felt like you were being completely rejected.

dialogue.content: ですかね…
dialogue.English: I guess so...

dialogue.content: ええ、そんなことを人に言うのはどんなことがあっても許されない行為ですよね
dialogue.English: Yes. Saying something like that to someone is an unforgivable act, no matter the reason.

dialogue.content: クラスの中に、お話できる人や一緒に過ごしてた人などはどんな人がいましたか？
dialogue.English: In your class, was there anyone you could talk to or spend time with?

dialogue.content: でも自分の顔はたしかに普通の人より劣っているので、言われてもやっぱそうなんだなって感じです
dialogue.English: But my face really is worse than the average person's, so when they say it I just feel like, 'Yeah, I guess that's true.'

dialogue.content: いないです
dialogue.English: No, there wasn't anyone.

dialogue.content: クラス変わってから言われたので
dialogue.English: They started saying it after the classes changed.

dialogue.content: そんなことないです、人を顔で判断できるはずがありません。それぞれお顔は違っていても一人一人が大切にされるべき人間なんです。
dialogue.English: That's not true. You can't judge a person by their face. Everyone's face is different, and every single person deserves to be treated with respect.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね、
dialogue.English: I see, so that's how it was.

dialogue.content: クラスが変わる前まではどんな人と一緒にいたのですか？
dialogue.English: Before you changed classes, who did you usually spend time with?

dialogue.content: それはそうだと思いますけど、顔も重要だと思います。第一印象は見た目からとも言いますし。
dialogue.English: I think that's true, but I also think appearance is important. People say first impressions are based on how you look.

dialogue.content: 小学校の友達とクラスが一緒だったのでその子といました。
dialogue.English: I was in the same class as a friend from elementary school, so I spent time with her.

dialogue.content: そう思われるのですね、ですが第一印象の見た目はどんな顔なのかではなく、どのような人なのかを見てると思います。身につけるものや仕草、発する言葉で人はとても印象が変わるものです。
dialogue.English: I can see why you'd think that. However, I believe a first impression isn't about what a person's face looks like, but about who they are as a person. The way someone dresses, their mannerisms, the words they use—these things can greatly change one's impression.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね、その小学校の友達はクラスが離れてしまったのですね、
dialogue.English: I see. So you and your friend from elementary school were put in different classes.

dialogue.content: まあそうですね
dialogue.English: Yeah, I guess so.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ええ、それは寂しかったですよね。
dialogue.English: That must have felt lonely.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: その子とはいま連絡は取られてますか？
dialogue.English: Are you still in contact with her?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね、どんなことを話されてるのですか？
dialogue.English: I see. What do you two talk about?

dialogue.content: 好きなものの話とかですかね
dialogue.English: Things we like, I guess.

dialogue.content: ええ、そうだったのですね
dialogue.English: I see, so that's what you talk about.

dialogue.content: あなたがいま学校に行けない状況や辛い気持ちをお話されましたか？
dialogue.English: Have you told her about not being able to go to school and how hard it's been?

dialogue.content: 少しは話しました。
dialogue.English: I've told her a little.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか、話してみてどんなふうに思われましたか？
dialogue.English: You did. How did you feel after talking to her about it?

dialogue.content: まあ少しは楽になりました
dialogue.English: Well, it helped a little.

dialogue.content: ええ、ええ、そうだったんですね、
dialogue.English: I see, yes, that's good to hear.

dialogue.content: とても仲のいいお友達なのですね、
dialogue.English: It sounds like you're very good friends.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ええ、
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: 今までお話しを伺ってみて、学校に行くのが辛いのであればわたしも無理をしていく必要はないと思いました。
dialogue.English: After hearing everything you've shared, I also think that you don't need to force yourself to go to school if it's too painful.

dialogue.content: ですが、やはりずっと行かないことで不安や心配事ができるのは自然だと思います
dialogue.English: However, I also think it's natural to have anxieties and worries arise from not going for a long time.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そこで、その不安をご両親にお話ししてみることや例えば、何らかの理由で学校に行けない子達が通うフリースクールなどもあります。そのような選択肢もあるでしょうし、
dialogue.English: With that in mind, one option could be talking to your parents about these anxieties. There are also places like "free schools" or alternative schools for children who can't attend regular school for various reasons. That could be another choice.

dialogue.content: とても仲のいい優しいお友達がいるのであれば、その子とできる限り学校での時間を過ごしたりしてみるなど、
dialogue.English: And since you have such a good, kind friend, perhaps you could try to spend as much time with her as possible at school.

dialogue.content: 考えてみたのですが、いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I've been thinking about these options. What are your thoughts?

dialogue.content: そうですね考えます
dialogue.English: Yes, I'll think about it.

dialogue.content: ええ、そう思ってくれてとても嬉しく思います。
dialogue.English: Yes, I'm very glad to hear you say that.

dialogue.content: どんなことなら出来そうでしょうか？
dialogue.English: What feels doable for you?

dialogue.content: まだわからないです
dialogue.English: I'm not sure yet.

dialogue.content: ええ、考えてくれてありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you for thinking about it.

dialogue.content: 先生や学校のカウンセラーなどに相談してみるのも一つだと思いましたが、どのように思われますか？
dialogue.English: I also thought that talking to a teacher or a school counselor could be an option. What do you think about that?

dialogue.content: そうですねできればやってみます
dialogue.English: Yes, I'll try if I can.

dialogue.content: ええ、とても勇気のいることですし、簡単なことではないと思います
dialogue.English: Yes, I know it takes a lot of courage and isn't easy.

dialogue.content: ですが少しずつでいいので、出来そうなことをやってみてください。
dialogue.English: It's okay to go little by little—try what feels manageable.

dialogue.content: 考えます
dialogue.English: I'll think about it.

dialogue.content: 今まで苦しいことに耐えて、怖い思いをされてきたのですからぜひ自分に優しい時間も作って欲しいと思います。
dialogue.English: You have endured so much pain and fear, so I truly hope you can make some time to be kind to yourself.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: ええ、はい、ぜひまた考えたことをこちらでお話し頂けますか？いつでも待ってます。
dialogue.English: Yes, please feel free to come back and talk about what you've thought over. I'll be here anytime.

dialogue.content: 気が向いたらそうします
dialogue.English: I'll do that if I feel up to it.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございます。そろそろお時間ですのでこちらで失礼させていただきます。今日は勇気を持って相談してくださりありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Okay, thank you. It's about time for us to finish, so we'll end here for today. Thank you for having the courage to come and talk with me.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: (お疲れ様でした。ありがとうございました。)
dialogue.English: (Thank you for your hard work today. Thank you.)

dialogue.content: (ありがとうございました。)
dialogue.English: (Thank you.)
